slots.title: Ramesh of the morning lane
slots.subtitle: Indira Market · chai, greetings, and the first light on Mandi streets
slots.body:
Before the shops fully wake, Ramesh sets his kettle on the corner where the bazaar narrows toward the river quarter. Regulars know the pour before they order — strong, sweet, and handed over with a nod that says the town is open.

He is not on a billboard. He is Mandi’s rhythm: early footsteps, steel tumblers, and the quiet pride of keeping a lane warm for whoever walks through.
